summary.tldr: Changes tax and pension rules so some people who qualify for provincial disability benefits are deemed to qualify federally, unless the minister decides otherwise.
what_it_does: Adds a rule under the Income Tax Act that a person who can deduct a provincial mental or physical impairment amount is deemed to meet the federal medical expense credit requirements, unless the minister decides otherwise.
Applies that tax change to the 2026 tax year and later.

Changes the Canada Pension Plan so a person is considered disabled, unless the minister decides otherwise, if they meet the current disability test and receive a provincial disability pension or benefit.
who_it_affects: People with mental or physical impairments
People claiming the disability tax credit
Canada Pension Plan disability benefit applicants
summary.background: The bill amends section 118.3 of the Income Tax Act and paragraph 42(2)(a) of the Canada Pension Plan.
